facts.fact: Short Stack 是一部家庭情景喜剧，1977 到 1985 年在 ABC 播出八季，周六晚 8:30 Eastern / 7:30 Central 档。
facts.anchor: Short Stack was a family sitcom that aired for eight seasons on ABC from 1977 to 1985, Saturday nights at 8:30 Eastern / 7:30 Central.

facts.fact: 剧中 breakout 人气角色 Lil’ Angus 的标志性口头禅「I dono about that!」首播期间一天能听十次；这句话登上过 TV Guide 和 Rolling Stone 两本封面，还衍生出 70 年代末 80 年代初的大量周边商品。
facts.anchor: Lil’ Angus’s iconic catchphrase, which you had to live under a rock not to hear ten times a day during the show’s initial run. That catchphrase graced the cover of both TV Guide and Rolling Stone, not to mention countless TV shirts, lunch boxes, and other merchandising tie-ins throughout the late seventies and early eighties.

facts.fact: 「Air Ball Blues」（S06E17）于 1983 年 2 月 5 日首播，是家庭情景喜剧在黄金档尝试过的最黑暗题材——它后来更广为人知的名字是「Lil’ Angus 差点被他的篮球教练性侵的那一集」。
facts.anchor: when “Air Ball Blues” first aired on February 5, 1983, it featured far and away the most controversial hot-button topic the show had bitten off to date, perhaps the darkest subject matter that any family-friendly sitcom had ever attempted to address in prime time.

facts.fact: 此前的「very special episodes」主题包括止痛药成瘾（S03E12「The Sting Operation」）、家庭暴力（S04E07「The Trouble with Andy’s Dad」）和越战 PTSD（S05E19–20，获艾美奖的「Those We Left Behind, Parts 1 and 2」）。
facts.anchor: Previous “very special episodes” had focused on painkiller addiction (S03E12, “The Sting Operation”), domestic violence (S04E07, “The Trouble with Andy’s Dad”), and PTSD from the still-fresh Vietnam War (S05E19–20, the Emmy-winning “Those We Left Behind, Parts 1 and 2”).

facts.fact: 该集当年获得 Outstanding Writing 类艾美提名，但最终输给 Cheers。
facts.anchor: (the episode, for what it’s worth, did receive a nomination in the Outstanding Writing category later that year, but ultimately lost to Cheers).

facts.fact: 多年后的 2009 年一个潮湿的七月夜晚，David Sawyer 和挚友 Erin Morrison 开车到纽约州 Troy，最后落入高中指导顾问 Jim Davis 的地下室；Jim 命令 Erin 脱光衣服、观看一盘写着她名字的 VHS 带。
facts.anchor: Years later, on a humid July night in 2009, David Sawyer and his best friend Erin Morrison drove to Troy, New York, and ended up in the basement of a very creepy high school guidance counselor named Jim Davis, who ordered Erin to strip nude and watch a VHS tape with her name on it.

facts.fact: Jim 那盘带子的片尾混入一条多余字幕「Script Girl—Erin Morrison」——这是 Short Stack 唯一一集带这种字幕；当时 Hollywood 已淘汰「Script Girl」头衔，而第六季真正的 Script Supervisor 名叫 Deborah Ingraham（该集拍摄播出比 Erin 出生早了近十年）。
facts.anchor: It’s the only episode of Short Stack with such a credit. By then, the title “Script Girl” had been phased out in Hollywood. “Script Supervisor” was now the less overtly sexist industry standard. And anyway, the Script Supervisor for season six of Short Stack was named Deborah Ingraham

facts.fact: David 于 7 月 6 日中午抵达 Troy——就在当天清晨，他第一次亲眼目睹挚友从静态中现身。
facts.anchor: It was midday by the time David arrived in Troy, New York, on July 6, the very same day when, early in the morning, he’d witnessed his best friend beam through the static for the first time.
